test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 8 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
If 'A + B' means 'A is the brother of B',

'A - B' means 'A is the sister of B',

'A × B' means 'A is the father of B',

then which of the following shows that 'L is the father of K'?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Decoding symbols:

 
 

 A is
 
 

 Symbol
 +
 –
 ×
 
 

 Meaning
 Brother
 Sister
 Father
 
 

 to B
 
 

So, checking each option one by one

Option 1) N + K - F × L → N is the brother of K who is the sister of F who is the father L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0f83e2e007c736572a05cd9ae8dcca0343d0443a1cac616b517909e0d52d8da3.png] 

Here, L is the child of F.

Option 2) F - L + N × K → F is the sister of L who is the brother of N who is the father K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/de1034c44f97dc18b5db434ec8d75c92626e2eed3e371ed04359b5181f4616ff.png] 

Here, L is the sister of F.

Option 3) K - N × L + F → K is the sister of N who is the father of L who is the brother F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8e37eb2686599375d5560081dfaf9e2caf2ec930576316373326339d3b9c40db.png] 

Here, L is the sister of F.

Option 4) L × W - K + F → L is the father of W who is the sister of F who is the brother L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/21646bad04ae069024e9f254beef64151cc2190f7ecb5f5a6ad4c0d9394a6bde.png] 

**Here, L is the father of F.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4"
